blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—At least two people were killed in a school shooting in South Cotabato on Friday, a regional disaster agency worker told Agence France–Presse. This is the country’s third deadly campus incident since June. Local rescuers received a call about gunfire on the campus of Banga National High School in South Cotabato at about 1:30 p.m. (0530 GMT). “From what I know, they are both students. There’s really no complete details as of now,” disaster agency worker Rolly Aquino said of the two victims. He added that at least seven people were being treated in hospital.
